topography.project_purpose: Derivatives. Structurally: 78 project-authored contract(s) across 3 chain(s); 7 ERC20 tokens, 1 ERC721 NFT; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 7 functional families. Its contracts share 8 common project-authored base contract(s) (accessibility, oftcore, oapp). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
